spikes.question: Can Codex CLI 0.141.0 be driven non-interactively to emit a parseable structured JSON verdict, and via which channel (positional arg / stdin / workspace-write file)?
spikes.result: CONFIRMED via 3 real codex runs. (1) prompt-as-positional-arg is UNRELIABLE on 0.141.0 (hangs printing "Reading additional input from stdin...", no output). (2) workspace-write + prompt-arg also hung; and a read-only reviewer should not have write access anyway, so file-drop is rejected. (3) Piping the prompt via STDIN to codex exec -s read-only -C <git-worktree> reliably makes Codex emit the exact verdict JSON as its final stdout message; parsed cleanly (decision=pass, findings=1). MECHANISM: stdin pipe + parse the structured JSON block from stdout, read-only, own bounded spawn (NOT runBoundedCodexProvider which hides stdout). Also found: codex 0.141.0 has NO --prompt-file flag, so the lattice-dispatch.ts:487 template [codex,exec,--prompt-file,...] is stale and must not be reused.
spikes.note: Disposable spike scripts (scratchpad/xhr-spike/*) deleted after they proved the stdin+stdout mechanism; the finding is retained as audit-only investigation evidence. The production mechanism is reimplemented cleanly in codex-review-leaf.ts during DEV, not from the scratch scripts.
